# BpmReadout

BPM in mono with tabular figures: whole numbers as "124", fractional as "123.5", with a half- or double-time reading in brackets ("87 (174)").

`SongNodes.BpmReadout` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.BpmReadout />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.BpmReadout"></x-import>
```

## Props (BpmReadoutProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` | BPM; one decimal shown only when fractional (123.5). |
| `to` | `number` | Upper bound for a range ("122–128"). |
| `alt` | `number` | Half- or double-time reading shown in brackets ("87 (174)"). |
| `unit` | `boolean` | Show the "BPM" unit after the number. |
| `size` | `"row" \| "lg"` | "row" (default) or "lg" for detail views. |
| `deltaFrom` | `number` | Previous track's BPM: renders the transition delta with its verdict instead. |
